description: This file defines a singleton class `SettingsWindowOpener` responsible for opening the Settings or Preferences window in a macOS app, utilizing AppKit and SwiftUI frameworks. It also declares a protocol for menu actions related to displaying these windows.

classes.name: SettingsWindowOpener
classes.description: A singleton class that manages opening the settings or preferences window in the application.

methods.name: register(openSettings:)
methods.description: Registers an OpenSettingsAction closure to customize setting window opening behavior.

methods.name: open()
methods.description: Activates the app and attempts to open the settings or preferences window via registered action or fallback menu commands.
